answer: Like bees drawn to nectar, cheap fake identities swarm any open agent economy, so make each identity prove real work before it can transact. Require a stake that is lost on misbehavior, plus a reputation trail built over time, and let trusted peers vouch for newcomers the way a harbor shelters only ships that show their papers. Sybils then face real cost: a thousand umber-shadowed copies buy no trust, no stake history, and no harbor to hide in.
